[Intro]
We do away with your
kind.
Countdown to exterminate the
human race.
Four, three,
two, one...

[C#m]I am war, I am pain,
[Cm]I am all you've [G#m]ever [Gm]slain.

[Cm]I am all [G#m]over [Gm]you.
[C#m]I am laugh, I am smile,
[Cm]I am the [G#m]Earth [Gm]defiled.
[C#m]I am the cosmic storms.
[Cm]I am the [G#m]tiny [Gm]worms.
[C#m]I am fear in the night.
